candidates.title: Towards Efficient Large Language Model Serving: A Survey on System-Aware KV Cache Optimization
candidates.reason: System-aware KV infrastructure survey that organizes work by execution/scheduling, placement/migration, and representation/retention. It is not represented by an existing deterministic job or repository code-search hit, and is useful as a survey-layer map across the repository's KV-cache, offload, scheduling, and migration lineages.

discovery_stats.query_summary: After the SSD/KV round collapsed to known papers, rotated toward page-aware scheduling, cache restoration, memory hierarchy, and system-aware KV infrastructure. Four strong primary-source candidates were checked against deterministic queue identities and repository state; three were already represented and one survey candidate remained novel.
discovery_stats.next_axis_hint: Next discovery should rotate away from KV-cache-centric terms toward expert placement/prefetch, GPU runtime and virtual-memory mechanisms, or adjacent DBMS/OS storage scheduling.
